sentences.text:
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:30248
Court No. - 19

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 9740 of 2023
Applicant :- Govind Chauhan
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Arjun Singh Kalhans,Lalu Prasad Bhatt Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1. Heard Sri Lalu Prasad Bhatt, the learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Abhishek Kumar Singh, the learned State Counsel and perused the record.
This is second bail application seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 363 of 2021, under Section 376 IPC, Police Station Tarabganj, District Gonda.

2. The First Bail application No. 3452 of 2022 was rejected by means of a order dated 23.05.2023,
after taking into consideration the fact that the victim was taken to Community Health Centre in the night, where she was given first aid and the doctor who had treated her in the Community Health Centre, had stated that the victim was bleeding and her condition was serious.
The victim remained admitted to the District Hospital for four days.
She consistently stated before the Investigating Officer as well as before the Magistrate, that the applicant had raped her.
Govind Chauhan vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

1 3.
The ground for seeking the applicant's release on bail through this second application, is that the complainant and the victim have been examined by the trial court.

Copies of statements of complainant and victim-PW 1 & 2 have been annexed with the rejoinder affidavit and a perusal of their statements indicates that they have clearly supported the prosecution version and there appears to be no major discrepancy in any of the statements.
4.

Accordingly, keeping in view the nature of allegations and the material relied upon by the prosecution, including statements of prosecution witnesses recorded by the trial court, there appears to be no good ground for exercising discretion of this Court in favour of the applicant by enlarging him on bail.
5. Accordingly, the bail application is rejected.

6. The learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant is languishing in jail since 14.12.2021 and only three witnesses have been examined till date whereas the right of expeditious conclusion of trial is fundamental right of the applicant.
7.

In view of the aforesaid fact, while rejecting the second bail application of the applicant, it is provided that the trial shall proceed with the trial expeditiously without granting unnecessary adjournment to any of the parties and shall conclude the same within a period of 18 months from the date of production of a copy of this order.

Order Date :- 16.4.2024 Pradeep/-
 
Govind Chauhan vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.
